summary.verdict: The SAME disease-agnostic substrate core that ranked PROTEINS (SUBSTRATE1) now ranks 2754 candidate MOLECULES purely by swapping providers — QED + SAscore (RANK) + PAINS (SAFETY_FILTER) — under identical provenance-tiered governance. It EXCLUDES 112 (4.1%) structural-alert (PAINS) liabilities by construction (0 in the shortlist — the molecule-half analogue of the host-toxic filter), ranks the rest by composed developability, and tiers confidence. This proves the 'any disease -> a query' architecture is ENTITY-AGNOSTIC and spans the whole pipeline (front-half proteins AND back-half molecules through ONE governance layer). SCOPE: free RDKit descriptors (QED/SAscore/PAINS) — a developability/liability composition demo, NOT activity or a validated drug; the honest binding/potency stage remains weak (C1/HIT2); outputs are hypotheses. Not wet-lab.
